word/document.xml.p2: Revision 1.1  |  11 October 2026  |  OWNER-APPROVED ARTISTIC DIRECTIONS / FIXTURES PENDING
word/document.xml.p3: Purpose: turn approved artistic directions into reviewable, testable contracts and a fixture acquisition plan. This is not a certificate of artistic quality, asset licensing, provider permission or readiness to execute live operations.
word/document.xml.p5: Owner-approved: five engines in architecture; painterly pet portrait; soft botanical watercolor; minimalist monochrome line art; classic vintage painted portrait; AI_TRANSFORM modes controlled painterly illustration and stylized poster art. Vintage catalog activation stays disabled.
word/document.xml.p6: Previously approved design controls: versioned typed contracts, shop isolation, immutable provenance, human review, deterministic evidence, fail-closed missing approvals, and no live calls/spending under STOP ALL.
word/document.xml.p7: Not yet supplied: licensed input/reference-output bytes, approved reviewer-signed reference pairs, named model/provider processing permissions, precise budget ceilings, supplier template-specific print limits, consent and retention records.
word/document.xml.p8: Acceptance rule: technical tests may pass with synthetic fixtures, but visual commercial certification remains PENDING until licensed human-approved reference evidence exists.
word/document.xml.p10: Reviewers compare source, approved reference, actual output and final print-size mockup at the same time. Record reviewer, UTC timestamp, engine/mode/contract revision, input/output SHA-256, template revision and outcome.
word/document.xml.p11: Hard reject: unauthorized subject added/removed; altered identifying marks or anatomy; unsafe/copyright-infringing added elements; unreadable requested text; clipped subject; visible print-edge/bleed failure; inconsistent approved personalization; cross-shop asset lineage.
word/document.xml.p12: Use a structured 0–3 rating for each applicable subjective dimension: 0=unusable, 1=major defect, 2=acceptable with no material defect, 3=excellent. PROPOSED acceptance: every critical dimension ≥2, zero hard rejects, and a reviewer-signed decision. Owner must approve these thresholds before certification.
word/document.xml.p13: Automated checks measure objective properties only: decoded pixels, dimensions, alpha/profile, template-specific DPI/bleed/safe-zone, hashes, allowed options, provenance and limits. Do not treat image similarity or pixel parity as proof of artistic fidelity.
word/document.xml.p14: Initial fixture matrix per enabled mode: at least 1 positive, 1 negative and 1 edge case for pipeline verification, plus multiple representative licensed source/reference pairs covering product families and subject variation before commercial sign-off. Exact sampling size remains owner-approved.
word/document.xml.p17: Review rubric: Critical: species, coat pattern, eye/ear shape, unique marks, pet count; review crop and background.
word/document.xml.p18: Fixture candidates (must be rights-cleared): Positive: one clearly photographed pet; negative: wrong coat/extra pet; edge: dark fur or partially occluded ears.
word/document.xml.p19: Execution gate: Launch: single pet; no invented accessories. Multi-pet and style variants remain gated.
word/document.xml.p22: Review rubric: Critical: recognizable botanical subject, intentional soft pigments, legible fine details, approved palette, no muddy artifacts.
word/document.xml.p23: Fixture candidates (must be rights-cleared): Positive: licensed flower/leaf reference; negative: lost botanical identity; edge: pale petals against light background.
word/document.xml.p24: Execution gate: Template-controlled background; transparency/paper texture must match selected approved mode.
word/document.xml.p26: Approved direction: Minimal monochrome contour artwork
word/document.xml.p27: Review rubric: Critical: defining contours, recognizable subject, adequate contrast, no accidental line gaps; supplier-specific printable stroke widths.
word/document.xml.p28: Fixture candidates (must be rights-cleared): Positive: clean source silhouette; negative: missing face/subject contours; edge: complex hair/fur or thin-line regions.
word/document.xml.p29: Execution gate: One-color initial mode; no universal stroke-width claim absent provider template.
word/document.xml.p31: Approved direction: Classic vintage painted portrait
word/document.xml.p32: Review rubric: Critical: recognizable source subject where applicable, coherent historical-inspired visual treatment, no deceptive provenance or identity claims.
word/document.xml.p33: Fixture candidates (must be rights-cleared): Positive: licensed source + era-approved reference; negative: false historic claim or identity drift; edge: varied skin tones and period accessories.
word/document.xml.p34: Execution gate: Capability present but catalog activation disabled; exact era and first product still require explicit approval.
word/document.xml.p36: Approved direction: Two named modes: controlled painterly illustration; stylized poster art
word/document.xml.p37: Review rubric: Critical: subject count, identity/recognizability where requested, approved composition, no unauthorized objects/text; per-mode review.
word/document.xml.p38: Fixture candidates (must be rights-cleared): Positive: approved mode-specific source/reference; negative: prompt injection or unexpected mode; edge: busy composition/text.
word/document.xml.p39: Execution gate: Only named modes; no free-form buyer prompt passed through; provider/model allowlist and cost ceiling pending.
word/document.xml.p41: CONTRACT_APPROVED: owner approved artistic direction and schema, but not necessarily model, spending or references.
word/document.xml.p42: PIPELINE_TESTED: deterministic synthetic tests pass; no artistic-quality claim.
word/document.xml.p43: VISUAL_REVIEW_PENDING: licensed reference/actual outputs or reviewer approval missing.
word/document.xml.p44: VISUAL_ACCEPTED: licensed fixture manifest complete and owner-designated reviewer signed engine/mode-specific evidence.
word/document.xml.p45: PRINT_CERTIFICATION_PENDING: no actual supplier-specific print proof/authorization.
word/document.xml.p46: RELEASE_BLOCKED: STOP ALL/external lock, finance/release gates or required permissions unresolved.
word/document.xml.p48: A companion CSV template is provided. Each fixture must have unique ID, engine/mode, positive/negative/edge role, source and reference SHA-256, provenance, rights and permitted derivative/AI use, consent if applicable, reviewer signature, supplier template, and immutable evidence location. Never store secrets in the manifest. Missing files remain explicitly MISSING.
word/document.xml.p50: Approve the proposed 0–3 visual rubric and critical-dimension threshold; appoint a reviewer and minimum representative fixture count.
word/document.xml.p51: Provide rights-cleared source images and reference outputs for each enabled engine/mode, with commercial derivative and AI-processing permission as applicable.
word/document.xml.p52: Select named AI provider/model versions and confirm processing, retention and commercial-use terms; set per-job, shop/day and engine/month monetary ceilings and retry policy.
word/document.xml.p53: Approve exact vintage era, initial catalog product, and activation timing (default: keep disabled).
word/document.xml.p54: Provide supplier-specific geometry, DPI, stroke, transparency and print-proof requirements for each intended product class.
word/document.xml.p55: Approve privacy, consent, retention and deletion wording for buyer-uploaded photographs.
word/document.xml.p57: Recommended: GPT-6.1 Sol / Medium / Standard. First ingest the approved contract and manifest schema. Implement only objectively testable validation, fixture ingestion, signed-review state transitions, mode-specific fail-closed gating and targeted regression tests not already present in PR #1161. Do not generate or certify licensed fixtures, enable live AI or supplier calls, spend money, merge or deploy. Finance #1147 untouched; STOP ALL ON, external lock ON, automation OFF.
word/document.xml.p59: Approved artistic directions: YES (per conversation). Proposed rubric and exact thresholds: PENDING. Fixture licensing and actual output references: PENDING. Provider/model and monetary ceilings: PENDING. Commercial visual certification: NOT ESTABLISHED.
